fixtures.title: Introduction
fixtures.text: Thanks for joining me today. My name is Maya, and I'll be your interviewer for this round.

fixtures.title: Specificity question
fixtures.text: What was the approximate monthly spend before and after the optimization, and which change contributed most to the reduction?

fixtures.title: Acknowledge + follow-up
fixtures.text: Okay. Could you walk me through a recent project where you balanced speed and quality?

fixtures.title: Contradiction check
fixtures.text: Earlier you mentioned five people on the platform team. Help me reconcile that with the migration plan you described.

fixtures.title: Silence prompt
fixtures.text: Take your time. Would you like me to repeat the question?

fixtures.title: Backchannel + transition
fixtures.text: Mm-hmm. Perfect, that makes sense. Let's shift gears to system design, beginning with a problem I find fun.
